title: Peggy's Cove and City Tour including Titanic Cemetery
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the perfect mix of coastal beauty and city history with our Peggy’s Cove & Halifax City Tour. Begin your journey exploring the vibrant city of Halifax, including famous landmarks such as the Halifax Waterfront, Citadel Hill, the Titanic Cemetery, Dalhousie University, and the beautiful Halifax Public Gardens. Learn about the city’s rich maritime history, culture, and local hidden gems along the way.

Then travel along Nova Scotia’s scenic coastline to the world-famous Peggy’s Cove Lighthouse. Explore the charming fishing village, walk across the rugged granite rocks, breathe in the fresh Atlantic air, and capture unforgettable oceanfront photos at one of Canada’s most iconic destinations.

This tour is perfect for cruise ship visitors, couples, families, and travelers looking to experience the very best of Halifax and Nova Scotia’s South Shore in one unforgettable trip.
